job.title: Casual Disability Support Workers
job.description:
Disability Support Worker - Casual | NSW SIL


Blu Healthcare is a leading healthcare recruitment agency proudly supporting NDIS providers, aged care facilities, community care services, disability organisations, and hospitals across Australia.

We are currently seeking experienced Disability Support Workers for casual shift opportunities across Goonellabah, Myocum, Lismore, Banora Point, Tweed Heads South and Ocean Shores.



About the Role

As a Disability Support Worker, you will provide high-quality, person-centred support to participants living in Supported Independent Living (SIL) homes.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Assisting participants with personal care and daily living activities
  • Medication administration
  • Manual handling and mobility assistance
  • Domestic assistance and meal preparation
  • Supporting participants with behaviours of concern in line with Positive Behaviour Support Plans (PBSPs)
  • Encouraging participation in community, social, and recreational activities
  • Providing support in both one-on-one and shared living environments
  • Transporting participants using either a company vehicle or your own registered and comprehensively insured vehicle.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Must hold a Certificate III / IV in Individual Support (Disability, Ageing, or equivalent)
  • Current Driver's Licence
  • Reliable, registered, and comprehensively insured vehicle
  • Current Blue Card
  • Current NDIS Worker Screening Check
  • Current National Police Check
  • Current First Aid and CPR Certificate
  • Completion of the NDIS Worker Orientation Module - Quality, Safety and You
  • Full Australian working rights
  • A genuine passion for supporting people with disabilities to achieve their goals and live independently
  • Previous experience working in Supported Independent Living (SIL), community disability support, or complex care is highly desirable.
  • Midazolam training preferred. Training costs will be reimbursed, subject to applicable conditions.

What We Offer

  • Competitive hourly pay rates
  • Flexible casual shifts, including morning, afternoon, overnight, sleepover, and weekend shifts
  • User-friendly mobile app to view, manage, and accept shifts
  • Kilometre reimbursement for approved community access shifts
  • Ongoing support from a dedicated recruitment and rostering team
  • Opportunities to gain experience across a wide range of disability support settings

If you are passionate about making a positive difference in the lives of people living with disability, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and join the Blu Healthcare team!

job.title: Personal Care Worker
job.description:
Blu Healthcare is a leading recruitment agency servicing the Australian health sector. We partner with a wide range of providers across aged care, disability services, community care, mental health, hospitals, and government health services.

We are currently recruiting qualified and dedicated Personal Care Workers for casual opportunities within aged care facilities located in the Gold Coast particularly in Southport, Labrador and Benowa and surrounding suburbs.

Position Summary

As a Personal Care Worker, you will play a vital role in supporting elderly residents with their day-to-day needs while promoting dignity, safety, and wellbeing in a professional care environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver personal care and assistance with activities of daily living.
  • Monitor and report changes in residents' health to the nursing team.
  • Participate in the implementation and review of resident care plans.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and comfortable environment for all residents.
  • Uphold resident confidentiality, dignity, and privacy at all times.
  • Work effectively within a team-based facility environment.

Essential Requirements

  • Certificate III in Individual Support (Aged Care) or equivalent is mandatory.
  • Prior experience in residential aged care settings is mandatory.
  • Full Australian working rights.
  • Current Queensland “C” Class Driver’s Licence.
  • National Police Check.
  • Flu Vaccinated
  • Current First Aid and CPR certification.
  • Yellow Card

  • Shift options to suit your availability:

    • Morning: 6:30 AM – 2:30PM
